scope: Authentication, sessions, accounts and their HTTP contracts only. These scoped requirements do not complete broader payment, scheduling, browser, security-scanning or release obligations in REQUIREMENTS.yaml.

requirements.statement: Normalized registration, hashed passwords, concurrent identity uniqueness and no caller-selected role.
Validate signed cookie sessions, all required claims, allowed algorithm, JWT expiry and persisted expiry through actual HTTP.
Durable logout revocation across independent processes and restart; disabled-user sessions are rejected.
CSRF is required on authentication and account commands, rotates on login/logout and remains usable during repeated ordinary commands.
Required provisioned keys, bounded authentication settings, secure normal cookies and explicit sandbox exceptions.
Multiple owner-assigned zero-balance wallets support CAD/USD/JPY/KWD, reject mass assignment and use exact decimal-string balances.
Owner-scoped account and nested-history queries reveal only the owner's economic effect.
Recipient lookup reveals only active public routing information and grants no private account access.
Database-backed ADMIN authority protects the real security-event feed and grants no generic customer spending or account creation.
Authentication throttling persists across instances and ignores spoofed forwarded addresses.
Bound pagination and request bodies, reject malformed or unknown input fields and return safe headers/errors.
Retain immutable account identity and runtime financial permissions; preserve historical V5 users/accounts through V6.
Serve the implemented OpenAPI and verify account wire fields without claiming later HTTP groups are complete.
The real TypeScript API client handles empty logout, CSRF refresh and registration without implicit login.
